_comment: Etsy requires a numeric taxonomy_id on every listing. IDs are specific to Etsy's live seller-taxonomy tree and MUST be looked up for real, not guessed — run `pnpm tsx scripts/fetch-etsy-taxonomy.ts` (repo root) after connecting your shop, find the right category in the printed tree, and fill in the ids below. The Publisher Agent refuses to publish a category with a null id rather than guessing wrong.
